{{Quote|It's an incredible fleet! Tens of thousands of ships!|Coruscant defender|<ref name="fall3" />}}
Following [[Gender/Legends|his]] ascension to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] assembled a massive armada of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] with which he planned to invade the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sadow then led the '''Sith invasion fleet''' in what was known as the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. After facing defeat at the hands of the Republic, Naga Sadow returned the fleet to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in hopes of rebuilding, but was met by the newly anointed Dark Lord [[Ludo Kressh]], who exiled him and his forces from the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] when Sadow refused to surrender. Not accepting his exile, Sadow sacrificed several of his remaining ships to defeat Kressh's forces. With much of the fleet gone, it was a pyrrhic victory, such that by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Republic and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] caught up to Sadow and his fleet the sole remaining ship was forced to rout.
